label: Organization
definition: Any legal entity participating in grantmaking, either as a funder or a recipient. The general category that Funder and Grantee specialize.

label: Funder
definition: An organization (foundation, government agency, corporation, or individual) that provides funding through grants.

label: Grantee
definition: An organization or individual that receives a grant award. Also called a recipient or subrecipient when funds are re-granted.

label: Fiscal Sponsor
definition: An organization that accepts and administers grant funds on behalf of a project or group that isn't itself a legal entity able to receive grants directly.

label: Program Officer
definition: An individual at a funder responsible for managing a portfolio of grants, from soliciting or reviewing applications through monitoring active awards.

label: Reviewer
definition: An individual (staff, board member, or external peer reviewer) who evaluates an application against review criteria.

label: Grant Administrator
definition: An individual at the grantee organization responsible for compliance, reporting, and financial management of an award.

label: Grant Program
definition: A funder's standing area of giving (e.g., "Environmental Justice Grants"), under which funding opportunities are issued over time.

label: Funding Opportunity
definition: A specific, time-bound invitation to apply for funding under a grant program, with defined eligibility, focus area, and deadlines.

label: Funding Cycle
definition: A recurring period (e.g., quarterly, annual) within a grant program during which applications are accepted and decided.

label: Eligibility Criteria
definition: The conditions an organization or project must meet to apply to a funding opportunity.

label: Budget
definition: A structured estimate of costs associated with a proposed or funded project, broken into categories (e.g., personnel, overhead, direct program costs).

label: Letter of Inquiry
definition: A brief, preliminary submission used by some funders to screen interest before inviting a full application.

label: Application
definition: A grantee's formal submission requesting funding under a specific funding opportunity, including a proposal narrative and budget.

label: Review
definition: The process of evaluating an application, producing a recommendation and often a score, conducted by one or more reviewers.

label: Review Criteria
definition: The published or internal standards (e.g., alignment with mission, feasibility, budget reasonableness) against which applications are scored.

label: Site Visit
definition: An optional step where a funder representative visits or meets with an applicant to assess capacity or verify claims before a decision.

label: Decision
definition: The outcome of the review process for an application: approved, declined, or approved with conditions.

label: Award
definition: A funder's formal commitment to provide a specific amount of funding to a grantee, following an approved application or decision.

label: Grant Agreement
definition: The legal document, signed by both funder and grantee, that formalizes an award's terms, conditions, and obligations.

label: Terms and Conditions
definition: The specific obligations, restrictions, and expectations attached to an award (e.g., allowable uses of funds, reporting requirements).

label: Restricted Funding
definition: Funding that must be used for a specific purpose, project, or time period defined in the grant agreement.

label: Unrestricted Funding
definition: Funding a grantee may use at its discretion in support of its general mission.

label: Matching Requirement
definition: A condition requiring the grantee to raise or contribute additional funds alongside the award, often as a ratio (e.g., 1:1 match).

label: Amendment
definition: A formally agreed change to an existing grant agreement's terms, budget, timeline, or amount, made after the original agreement was signed.

label: Payment Schedule
definition: The agreed timing and amounts by which award funds will be disbursed to the grantee.

label: Installment
definition: A single scheduled portion of an award's total funds, to be disbursed at a defined point or upon meeting a condition.

label: Payment
definition: An actual transfer of funds from funder to grantee against an award, corresponding to one or more installments.

label: Payment Condition
definition: A requirement (e.g., a submitted report, a milestone reached) that must be satisfied before a scheduled payment is released.

label: Budget Modification
definition: A grantee-requested, funder-approved change to how awarded funds are allocated across budget categories, without changing the total award amount.

label: Compliance Requirement
definition: An obligation attached to an award that the grantee must satisfy to remain in good standing (e.g., timely reporting, allowable use of funds, insurance).

label: Reporting Schedule
definition: The agreed cadence and due dates for narrative and financial reports over the life of an award.

label: Report
definition: A grantee's submission to the funder describing progress, outcomes, and/or use of funds, per the reporting schedule. Narrative and financial reports are common subtypes.

label: Audit
definition: A formal, independent examination of a grantee's financial records, either as a general organizational requirement or specific to a grant.

label: Indirect Cost Rate
definition: The negotiated or de minimis rate at which a grantee may charge overhead/administrative costs against an award.

label: Theory of Change
definition: A grantee's or funder's articulated model of how specific activities are expected to lead to desired long-term change.

label: Logic Model
definition: A structured diagram connecting a project's inputs, activities, outputs, and outcomes, used to plan and evaluate a grant-funded project.

label: Output
definition: A direct, countable product of grant-funded activity (e.g., number of workshops held, people served).

label: Outcome
definition: A change in condition, behavior, knowledge, or status that results from grant-funded activity, distinct from an output.

label: Evaluation
definition: A structured assessment of whether a grant-funded project achieved its intended outputs and outcomes.

label: Closeout
definition: The formal conclusion of a grant award once all funds are disbursed, all reports are submitted and accepted, and all compliance requirements are satisfied.

label: Grant Lifecycle
definition: The end-to-end sequence a grant moves through, from funding opportunity through application, review, award, disbursement, reporting, and closeout.
